usageRule: Deduplicate by usage.recordId and sum only SELF_ONLY records; INCLUSIVE records are display-only rollups.
currencyRule: Aggregate cost only within the same ISO 4217 currency and provenance bucket; never sum unlike currencies.
nullRule: Missing or unsupported measurements remain null with UNAVAILABLE provenance and are never represented as zero.

metrics.definition: Agents whose latest validated lifecycle state is active.
metrics.calculation: Count latest states in STARTING, RUNNING, TESTING, BLOCKED or HANDOFF.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE when the local runtime store cannot be read.

metrics.definition: Elapsed time from first retained agent event to its latest or terminal event.
metrics.calculation: durationMs when supplied, otherwise validated timestamp delta.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE when no retained agent sample exists.

metrics.definition: Recorded retries relative to completed runs in the selected window.
metrics.calculation: RETRY_RECORDED / completed runs; no denominator produces UNAVAILABLE.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE when no completed-run denominator exists.

metrics.definition: Failed skill executions relative to started skill executions.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE when no skill starts exist.

metrics.definition: Failed tool executions relative to started tool executions.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE when no tool starts exist.

metrics.definition: Work items whose first independent QA result passed.
metrics.calculation: First QA gate passes / first QA gate results by work item.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE when independent first-result evidence is absent.

metrics.definition: Accepted work items requiring one or more governed rework cycles.
metrics.calculation: Accepted work items with reworkCycle greater than zero / accepted work items.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE when accepted-work denominator is absent.

metrics.definition: Work items that required a durable human decision.
metrics.calculation: Distinct HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED work items / distinct governed work items.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE when governed-work denominator is absent.

metrics.definition: Provider/runtime token usage for unique self-only usage records.
metrics.calculation: Deduplicated SELF_ONLY usage.totalTokens grouped by provenance.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE until a supported runtime source reports usage.

metrics.calculation: Deduplicated SELF_ONLY providerCost grouped by currency and provenance.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE; currencies and provenance are never mixed.

metrics.definition: Recorded external tool or adapter cost.
metrics.calculation: Deduplicated SELF_ONLY toolCost grouped by currency and provenance.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE; missing values are not inferred.

metrics.definition: Cached input relative to recorded input where provider semantics are available.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE when cache counters are unsupported.

metrics.definition: Validated reused context relative to loaded context.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE when no validated context record exists.

metrics.definition: Unique self-only tokens attributed to independently accepted stories.
metrics.calculation: Deduplicated SELF_ONLY totalTokens / independently accepted stories.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE when either token or accepted-story evidence is absent.

metrics.definition: Accepted execution cost per Stage-QA and BA accepted UAT-ready candidate.
metrics.calculation: Deduplicated accepted SELF_ONLY costs / UAT_READY releases by currency.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE until a valid UAT-ready denominator and cost evidence exist.

metrics.definition: Distinct governed defects linked to implemented stories.
metrics.calculation: Distinct type:defect records with story linkage / stories with implementation evidence.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE when story linkage or denominator is incomplete.

metrics.definition: Elapsed governed time from work-item start to accepted completion.
metrics.calculation: Accepted completion timestamp minus first WORK_ITEM_STARTED timestamp.
metrics.nullHandling: UNAVAILABLE for active or uncorrelated work.
